stem:
Which part of the sentence has an error? If the sentence is correct, choose "No error".

Yesterday, the mayor visit the new health center in our barangay.
hints: Look for a word that tells you when the action happened.
"Yesterday" tells you the action is already finished. It happened in the past.
A finished action needs the past tense form of the verb, which usually ends in -ed. Check the verb against the time word, then check the other parts.

solution.methodName: Find the time clue, then match the verb

steps.why: Words like yesterday, last week, ago and in 2020 tell you the action is in the past.

steps.action: Find the verb: "visit". It is in the present tense.
Change it to the past tense: "visited".
steps.why: A finished action takes the past form. Most verbs add -ed: visit, visited.

steps.action: Check the other parts. "Yesterday, the mayor" and "in our barangay" are correct.
The error is "visit the new health center". It should be "visited the new health center".

trapNotes.Yesterday, the mayor: This part is correct. The time word and the subject are fine. It is the verb after them that does not match "yesterday".
trapNotes.in our barangay: This part is correct. We use "in" for an area such as a barangay or a city.
trapNotes.No error: "Visit" may slip by when you read quickly. But "yesterday" makes the action past, so the verb must be "visited".
